# Files synced from https://github.com/ecmwf/reusable-workflows/tree/main/sync-files that this repository owns.
#
# The `protect-synced-files` pre-commit hook rejects local changes to synced files, except for the paths listed here.
# A path listed here MUST also be excluded for this repository in
# https://github.com/ecmwf/reusable-workflows/blob/main/sync-files/sync.yml
# otherwise the next sync overwrites the local version.
#
# One repository-relative path per line, `#` starts a comment.
